cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Growth-Driven Marketing Manager position at Nomad Capitalist. Your emphasis on execution, data, and a remote-first, low-bureaucracy approach is exactly the environment where I do my best work.

As a digital marketer with a technical background, I've spent the past years building and optimizing websites for both traditional and AI-powered search. In my current role at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client sites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also manage CMS content in WordPress, ensuring pages and blog posts are current and performing. On the freelance side, I designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com, implementing structured data, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt files, and running iterative technical audits that measurably improved search health.

What draws me to this role is the chance to own marketing activities end-to-end—email campaigns, agency collaboration, and performance analysis—without lengthy corporate processes. I'm comfortable working with internal teams and external partners, and I use AI tools and Python automation daily to cut repetitive work and focus on what moves the needle. My front-end development experience (AngularJS, JavaScript) also means I can speak the language of web teams and troubleshoot quickly.

I'm fluent in English, based in Belgium, and set up for remote work. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my mix of SEO, content, analytics, and automation can support Nomad Capitalist's growth goals.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
